stories.title: 'I want to build dynasties here': How the Valkyries built a title winner in just two years
stories.summary: When Golden State joined the WNBA, the owner said the team would win a title within five years. The Valkyries did it in two.

stories.title: Valkyries outlast Dream in Game 7, secure first WNBA title
stories.summary: Gabby Williams scored 30 points and was named Finals MVP, after leading the Golden State Valkyries to their first WNBA title with a 68-63 Game 7 victory over the Atlanta Dream on Saturday night at the Chase Center in San Francisco.

stories.title: USC upsets No. 2 Ohio State for biggest win of Riley's tenure
stories.summary: Jayden Maiava passed for 222 yards and a touchdown, King Miller and Waymond Jordan rushed for scores, and USC stunned No. 2 Ohio State 30-18 on Saturday night for the biggest win of head coach Lincoln Riley's tenure.

stories.title: Miami dodges upset in Chapel Hill, looks ahead to Notre Dame
stories.summary: Malachi Toney and the No. 1 Miami Hurricanes rallied in the fourth quarter Saturday night, extracting a 38-35 win over the North Carolina Tar Heels and avoiding a seismic upset to improve to 8-0 with Notre Dame on the schedule next week.

stories.title: Clemson's Swinney irked by 'shameful' plane banner urging FSU to fire Norvell
stories.summary: Before Florida State's 36-24 loss to Clemson on Saturday night, a plane carrying a banner urging the school to fire Seminoles coach Mike Norvell hovered over Doak Campbell Stadium, a move Tigers coach Dabo Swinney called "embarrassing" and "shameful."
